items.title_zh: 这些无糖 Haribo 小熊软糖的评论太多了：第一部分
items.title_en: These Sugarless Haribo Gummy Bear Reviews Are Too Much: Part One
items.summary_zh: 您读过 Haribo 小熊软糖的评论吗？人们对这种无糖零食有一些强烈的看法，或者我应该说强烈的反应吗？你告诉我。 “一定要买 Oxyclean！” “一定要买一桶 Oxyclean 来清除你的内衣、衣服、家具、宠物、亲人、吊扇上的血迹和腹泻污渍。”走出大门，这是 Haribo 小熊软糖评论中最好的评论之一。
items.summary_en: Have you ever read the Haribo Gummy Bear reviews? People have some strong opinions about this sugarless snack or should I say strong reactions? You tell me. “Be sure to buy Oxyclean too!” “Be sure to also buy a tub of Oxyclean with this to get the blood and diarrhea stains out of your underwear, clothes, furniture, pets, loved ones, ceiling fans.” Out the gate, is this one of the best of the Haribo Gummy Bear Reviews.
